recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied resolution by fixing the authoritative source field that remained stale, without broadening the decision beyond the WG-approved no-statusReason and excludeFoodModifier clarification scope.
issue_request: FHIR-46700 asked why the request-pattern resource remains named NutritionOrder, asked for a statusReason element, and asked for rationale/context around excludeFoodModifier. The Applied, Not Persuasive with Modification resolution retained the NutritionOrder name, declined statusReason because practice examples do not support it, and required clearer excludeFoodModifier long and short descriptions.
initial_application: The prior multi-issue NutritionOrder commit de8f14ac79f7ecf959a2c097ae8823ad8b8ab7a7 listed FHIR-46700 and applied the revised excludeFoodModifier long description in source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml. It also replaced the comment with the first sentence of the requested short text, but left the actual ElementDefinition.short as "Food that should not be given."
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists nutritionorder=NutritionOrder, so the StructureDefinition is in current build scope. source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-request-mapping-exceptions.xml still records Request.statusReason as unmapped, consistent with the WG decision not to add NutritionOrder.statusReason. OO Nutrition minutes for 2024-11-20 list FHIR-46700 and record the 9-0-0 vote. Zulip searches for the issue and key NutritionOrder terms found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml so NutritionOrder.excludeFoodModifier.short now says: "Specific types of oral food (solid/liquid) to avoid. It complements but does not duplicate AllergyIntolerance." No statusReason element was added and generated diagram output was not edited.
source_changes: source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml: updated NutritionOrder.excludeFoodModifier.short to the resolved text explaining that the element complements but does not duplicate AllergyIntolerance.
